title: Asked by vg-paradigms: CI by hand, not on every push (rule ci.on-demand)
body:
CI by hand, not on every push (rule ci.on-demand) (graft:01a19343-7159..58bf, from vg-paradigms)

What was needed:
- vg-paradigms: Workflow triggers per the baseline rule ci.on-demand (only the user commits; dependabot comes in through pull requests, which stay covered). (1) .github/workflows/ci.yml: replace `push: branches: [main]` with `workflow_dispatch:`, keeping `pull_request:`. (2) .github/workflows/deny.yml: take release 2026.10.7 and render (`tend baseline render --write`): the rendered deny.yml runs on workflow_dispatch and pull_request only and has your `rustup toolchain install` step (your graft 01a1909b). (3) .github/workflows/notices.yml: drop the `push:` trigger and keep `workflow_dispatch:`. The Miri job's nightly stays as it is: the rule allows a nightly where only nightly will do.

Answer (done): Done past what was asked, by the rule that replaced it (ci.contributors-only, release 2026.10.11) and the user's choice: autodyne has no workflows. ci.yml, deny.yml and notices.yml are removed, and dependabot.yml keeps only cargo updates. Every check runs locally before each commit (README, Tests and benchmarks). Before a release, the NEON tests run on an aarch64 machine and Miri runs locally (nightly), and plugin notices come from `cargo xtask notices`. The user turns GitHub Actions off for the repo. Rendered at 2026.10.11, which no longer renders deny.yml here.
